ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of a cell structure, with multiple white label boxes using guide lines to point to different structures inside the cell. Label H is located at the lower left of the image, and its guide line points to a red oval/bean-shaped small structure inside the lower left of the cell; inside this structure there are folded wavy membrane lines. Then reason: in biological cell schematic diagrams, an organelle that is oval or bean-shaped and has folded membranes/cristae inside usually represents a mitochondrion. Therefore, H labels the mitochondrion.
